p: altar: Which was at Jerusalem: for he did not appear in the idolatrous places of Israel.
head: Both the most important of them, and also the common people.
serpent: He shows that God will declare himself as an enemy to them in all places, and that his elements and all his creatures will be enemies to destroy them.
stories in the heaven: He declares by the wonderful power of God, by the making of the heavens and the elements, that it is not possible for man to escape his judgments when he punishes.
unto me: Am I more bound to you than to the Ethiopians, or other people? Yet I have bestowed upon you greater benefits.
destroy the house of Jacob: Though he destroys the rebellious multitude, yet he will always reserve the remnant of his Church to call upon his name.
least grain fall upon the earth: Meaning that none of his own would perish in his wrath.
tabernacle of David that is fallen: I will send the promised Messiah, and restore by him the spiritual Israel; Ac 15:16.
Edom: Meaning, the very enemies (as were the Edomites) and others would be united with the Jews in one society and body, of which Christ would be the head.
overtake the reaper: Signifying, that there will be great abundance of all things, so that when one type of fruit is ripe, another would follow, and every one in order; Le 26:5.
And I will bring again the: The accomplishment of this is under Christ, when they are planted in this Church, out of which they can never be pulled, after they have once been grafted into it.
